verdict.rationale: Veriff's own public API covers the core verification lifecycle. You can create sessions, submit your own media with a custom front-end, poll decisions, and receive webhooks. However, several operations are documented only in the Customer Portal UI: manual review, setting user-defined statuses, and team and admin management via the Team page. That points to incomplete API-to-UI parity, and the OpenAPI probe found no published spec. Missing for 10: documented API equivalents for manual review and decisioning, user-defined statuses, team and user administration, and PDF export, plus a published OpenAPI spec or an explicit parity statement.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: Use this endpoint to **initiate a new verification session** for an end-user. Every verification flow begins with creating a session.
